content: anthropic Python SDK: already in use at >=0.72.0. client.messages.parse(output_format=MyPydanticModel) uses beta 'structured-outputs-2025-12-15'. Tool-use approach also valid (define tool with schema, force tool_choice). Current advise() in advisor.py uses client.messages.parse(output_format=Advice) which is the cleanest path. The grounding invariant is enforced at the system prompt level. Adaptive thinking supported with thinking={'type': 'adaptive'}.
